arxiv-2103-12704.title: Quasi-stationary solutions in non-Hermitian systems
arxiv-2103-12704.creator: Cem Yuce
arxiv-2103-12704.description: Abstract Eigenstates exhibit localization at an open edge in a non-Hermitian lattice due to non-Hermitian skin effect. We here explore another interesting feature of non-Hermitian skin effect and predict quasi-stationary solutions, which are approximately time-independent. We show that the transition from such states to eigenstates is dramatically non-perturbative.

arxiv-2205-07350.title: LEPTONIC 𝒈 − 𝟐 \bm{g-2} IN 2HDM
arxiv-2205-07350.creator: FRANCISCO J. BOTELLA, FERNANDO CORNET-GOMEZ, CARLOS MIRÓ, MIGUEL NEBOT
arxiv-2205-07350.description: Abstract The experimental observations of the electron and muon anomalous magnetic moment present discrepancies with respect to the Standard Model predictions. A class of flavor conserving Two Higgs Doublet model, stable under renormalization, that is capable of explaining both anomalies simultaneously is presented.

arxiv-2301-13567.title: The fundamental solution of the master equation for a jump-diffusion Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process
arxiv-2301-13567.creator: Olga S. Rozanova*, Nikolai A. Krutov
arxiv-2301-13567.description: Abstract . An integro-differential equation for the probability density of the generalized stochastic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with jump diffusion is considered for a special case of the Laplacian distribution of jumps. It is shown that for a certain ratio between the intensity of jumps and the speed of reversion, the fundamental solution can be found explicitly, as a finite sum.

arxiv-2307-12665.title: Thin Film Equations with Nonlinear Deterministic and Stochastic Perturbations
arxiv-2307-12665.creator: Oleksiy Kapustyan, Olha Martynyuk, Oleksandr Misiats, Oleksandr Stanzhytskyi
arxiv-2307-12665.description: Abstract In this paper we consider stochastic thin-film equation with nonlinear drift terms, colored Gaussian Stratonovych noise, as well as nonlinear colored Wiener noise. By means of Trotter-Kato-type decomposition into deterministic and stochastic parts, we couple both of these dynamics via a discrete-in-time scheme, and establish its convergence to a non-negative weak martingale solution. 1 Introduction.

arxiv-2312-13017.title: Electron tunneling induced thermoelectric effects
arxiv-2312-13017.creator: Mauricio Gómez Viloria, Riccardo Messina, Philippe Ben-Abdallah
arxiv-2312-13017.description: Abstract We introduce a direct (Seebeck) and inverse (Peltier) thermoelectric effect induced by electron tunneling between closely separated conducting films. When a transverse temperature gradient is applied along one of two films, a bias voltage is induced in the second thanks to the heat transfer mediated by electron tunneling through the separation gap.

arxiv-2403-18372.title: Bulk-entanglement spectrum correspondence in P ​ T PT - and P ​ C PC -symmetric topological insulators and superconductors
arxiv-2403-18372.creator: Ryo Takahashi, Tomoki Ozawa
arxiv-2403-18372.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ryo Takahashi, Tomoki Ozawa. In this study, we discuss a new type of bulk-boundary correspondence which holds for topological insulators and superconductors when the parity-time ( P ​ T PT ) and/or parity-particle-hole ( P ​ C PC ) symmetry are present. In these systems, even when the bulk topology is nontrivial, the edge spectrum is generally gapped, and thus the conventional bulk-boundary correspondence does not hold.

arxiv-2510-11671.title: Finite-temperature phase diagram and collective modes of coherently coupled Bose mixtures
arxiv-2510-11671.creator: Sunilkumar V, Rajat, Sandeep Gautam, Arko Roy
arxiv-2510-11671.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sunilkumar V, Rajat, Sandeep Gautam, Arko Roy. We investigate the ferromagnetic–paramagnetic phase transition in coherently (Rabi) coupled Bose-Einstein condensates at zero and finite temperatures, exploring different routes to the transition by tuning the Rabi coupling or increasing the temperature at a fixed coupling. Using the Hartree–Fock–Bogoliubov theory within the Popov approximation, we map out the finite-temperature phase diagram of a three-dimensional homogeneous condensate and identify the critical line through the softening of the spin gap.

arxiv-2510-21984.title: From Social Division to Cohesion with AI Message Suggestions in Online Chat Groups
arxiv-2510-21984.creator: Faria Huq, Elijah L. Claggett, Hirokazu Shirado
arxiv-2510-21984.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Faria Huq, Elijah L. Claggett, Hirokazu Shirado. Social cohesion is difficult to sustain in societies marked by opinion diversity, particularly in online communication. As large language model (LLM)-driven messaging assistance becomes increasingly embedded in these contexts, it raises critical questions about its societal impact. We present an online experiment with 557 participants who engaged in multi-round discussions on politically controversial topics while freely reconfiguring their discussion groups.

arxiv-2511-13302.title: Polynomial invariants of cyclically ordered graphs
arxiv-2511-13302.creator: Paul Bratch, M. N. Ellingham, Joanna A. Ellis-Monaghan, Iain Moffatt, Wout Moltmaker
arxiv-2511-13302.description: Abstract . Cyclically ordered graphs, or cogs , sit between abstract graphs and cellularly embedded graphs. They arise naturally in topological graph theory, knot theory, and mathematical biology. We develop a formal theory of cogs and establish a number of invariants of cogs.

arxiv-2512-15736.title: Aṇubuddhi: A Multi-Agent AI System for Designing and Simulating Quantum Optics Experiments
arxiv-2512-15736.creator: S. K. Rithvik
arxiv-2512-15736.description: Abstract We present Aṇubuddhi, a multi-agent AI system that designs and simulates quantum optics experiments from natural language prompts without requiring specialized programming knowledge. The system composes optical layouts by arranging components from a three-tier toolbox via semantic retrieval, then validates designs through physics simulation with convergent refinement.

pmc-12428301.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryActinic keratoses are common, UV-induced precancerous lesions.
